### Church & Dwight to Webcast Discussion of Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results on October 30


October 9, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/233583214/files/doc_news/Church--Dwight-to-Webcast-Discussion-of-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Results-on-October-30-2026.pdf)


EWING, N.J.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Church & Dwight Co., Inc. (NYSE: CHD) will webcast a discussion of its third quarter earnings results on Friday, October 30, 2026, beginning at 10:00 a.m. ET.


Media and investors may access the live audio webcast at[https://investor.churchdwight.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.churchdwight.com%2F&esheet=54619060&newsitemid=20261009203102&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.churchdwight.com%2F&index=1&md5=3a9c3f9ab4dd2bc71c7c70636c545c0c) beginning at 10:00 a.m. ET. The webcast will also be available for replay.


Church & Dwight Co., Inc. (NYSE: CHD) founded in 1846, is the leading U.S. producer of sodium bicarbonate, popularly known as baking soda. The Company manufactures and markets a wide range of personal care, household, and specialty products under recognized brand names such as ARM & HAMMER®, TROJAN®, OXICLEAN®, FIRST RESPONSE®, NAIR®, ORAJEL®, XTRA®, BATISTE®, WATERPIK®, ZICAM®, THERABREATH®, HERO®, TOUCHLAND® and MISS MOUTH’S®. For more information, visit the Company’s website.
